title: Sample batch
description: Raw samples collected during one test execution, attached to the test result as the 'pw-perf-samples' attachment (ADR-0003). In perf mode every test in a measured project gets this attachment, even when it is empty (05-REQ-15). Written by the collector, read by the reporter. Test metadata is not included; the reporter adds it from TestCase/TestResult.

name.description: Collector identifier. 'playwright-js' in MVP; other ecosystems use their own (14).

browserName.description: Browser engine (chromium, firefox, webkit), or null when the test used no browser.

requests.description: Request samples in the order they finished; requests still in flight when the end-of-test wait ran out come last, with status PENDING (05).

apiRequests.description: Calls of APIRequestContext methods (request fixture, page.request, context.request, trackRequestContext; 15) in the order they finished; calls still running when the end-of-test wait ran out come last, with status PENDING. The reporter keys them with the prefix 'request ' (15-REQ-01).

diagnostics.description: Collector diagnostics caught during the test (01-REQ-13, 05 §9). Repeated issues are collapsed using 'count'. The reporter turns every diagnostic into an entry in 'warnings' (09-REQ-23); none of them is a tool error.

operation.description: Operation names read by keys.operations (18-REQ-09), in request order; null when the request matched no entry or no name could be read. Written only when keys.operations is not empty; a missing field means null. Never the request body (P-07).

apiRequestSample.description: One call of an APIRequestContext method, timed with the worker's clock (15-REQ-05).

method.description: HTTP method, uppercase (fetch without a method: GET).

url.description: Called URL: absolute as given, a relative one resolved against the test's baseURL, otherwise response.url() or the text of the call (15-REQ-05). Never written to thresholds files (P-07).

status.description: HTTP status code; FAILED when the call threw; PENDING when it was still running after the end-of-test wait (15-REQ-08).

failureText.description: First line of the error message of the call. Present only when status is FAILED.

startTime.description: Date.now() when the method was called, whole ms.

duration.description: From the call to the settled promise (performance.now() in the worker), including reading the whole body. Null for FAILED and PENDING.

source.description: request: the request fixture; context: page.request or context.request; tracked: a context passed to trackRequestContext(). Informational: all give keys with the same prefix (15-REQ-05).

requestSample.description: One backend request observed in a tracked browser context, after collector filters (05).

url.description: Full raw URL as reported by the browser. Never written to thresholds files (P-07).

resourceType.description: Playwright Request.resourceType(), e.g. document, xhr, fetch.

status.description: HTTP status code; FAILED when the request failed without a response; PENDING when it was still in flight after the end-of-test wait (05-REQ-13).

failureText.description: Request.failure().errorText; an empty text is recorded as 'unknown' (05-REQ-11). For requests still in flight when their page or context was closed by the test, the collector's CONTEXT_CLOSED_FAILURE_TEXT ('pw-perf: context closed', 05-REQ-30). Present only when status is FAILED. 08-REQ-30 relabels abort texts (e.g. net::ERR_ABORTED and CONTEXT_CLOSED_FAILURE_TEXT) as ABORTED.

startTime.description: Request start (Request.timing().startTime), rounded to whole ms.

duration.description: From request start to the last response byte (timing.responseEnd). Includes browser queueing, DNS, connection setup, TLS and a CORS preflight (see requestStart; 05-REQ-26). Null when unknown: FAILED, PENDING, or a response whose requestfinished event never came, e.g. a body the page did not read (05-REQ-31); such a sample keeps its HTTP status and counts in statuses but not in time statistics.

requestStart.description: timing.requestStart: time from request start until the browser began sending the request, i.e. queueing, DNS, connection and TLS (05-REQ-26). Does not include a CORS preflight: for preflighted requests the browser measures requestStart and responseStart from the start of the actual request, so the preflight shows only in duration (05-REQ-26). Informational; not evaluated. Null when the browser did not report it or for FAILED/PENDING.

ttfb.description: timing.responseStart - timing.requestStart; never includes a CORS preflight (05-REQ-26). Null when the browser did not report both values.

timeSource.description: browser: timings from Request.timing(); node: fallback measured in the worker when browser timing was unavailable (05).

fromServiceWorker.description: True when Response.fromServiceWorker() reported that a service worker produced the response; such samples are excluded from time statistics (05-REQ-05). False for FAILED and PENDING.
